admission.justification: Both shapes were live (SourceExplorer/UnexplainedLane/panel vs page); every later file/worklist/disclosure change must keep the single page, the own view and the count.

alternatives.option: Change-set page on the comparison's trees with filters and return; worklist behind its own tree row; at most twenty disclosures per main-page view; knowledge diff out of the leaf-wide view.
alternatives.reason: D48 as carried by rules 12-22: one diff owner, one worklist place, no per-file/per-item disclosures.

alternatives.option: Reviewer-owned file lists with focused diffs plus the Knowledge-changes panel with raw patches and per-item facts dumps.
alternatives.reason: D48 rules it out: three file lists for the same 179 files and 1,037 panel disclosures.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A comparison the change-set routes cannot name must still be judged file by file inside the review.

consequences: Later file/worklist/disclosure work keeps the single comparison page, the own worklist view and the disclosure count.
context: Developer direction D48 with D47 on the L86 main page (2026-10-04): unexplained/unknown attribution opens a full-page diff viewer with return; no source-change bar; default to changed first; the leaf worklist as a view of its own.
